description: Patent Intelligence ZY: patent Image Search API.

country.description: The country/organization/region code of the patent acceptance office. Multiple ones are separated by English commas; if not passed, it means all the acceptance offices.

includeMachineTranslation.description: Whether the search includes machine translation data.

isHttps.description: Image domain name protocol: `1` returns HTTPS, `0` returns HTTP.

legalStatus.description: Detailed legal status codes, multiple separated by English commas: `1` public, `2` substantive review, `3` authorized, `8` avoid repeated authorization, `11` withdrawn, `12` withdrawn-unspecified type, `17` Withdrawal - deemed withdrawal, `18` withdrawal - active withdrawal, `13` rejection, `14` all withdrawal, `15` expiration of term, `16` unpaid annual fee, `21` rights restoration, `22` rights termination, `23` Partially invalid, `24` application terminated, `30` abandoned, `19` abandoned - deemed abandoned, `20` abandoned - voluntary abandoned, `25` abandoned - unspecified type, `222` PCT did not enter the designated country - within the designated period, `223` PCT Entering the designated country - within the designation period, `224` PCT entering the designated country - the designation period expires, `225` PCT not entering the designated country - the designation period expires.

loc.description: LOC classification, multiple classification numbers can be connected using `AND`/`OR`/`NOT`.

mainField.description: Main patent fields, including title, abstract, claims, specification, publication number, application number, applicant, inventor, and IPC/UPC/LOC classification number, maximum 1,000 characters.

model.description: Appearance patents: `1` (intelligent Lenovo, recommended), `2` (search this picture); utility models: `3` (matching shape), `4` (matching shape/pattern/color, recommended).

order.description: Valid when `field` is a date field: `desc` or `asc`.

patentType.description: Patent type: `D` (appearance patent) or `U` (utility model patent); the utility model skill uses `U` permanently.

preFilter.description: Whether to enable prefix country/LOC filtering: `1` is on, `0` is off.

simpleLegalStatus.description: Simple legal status: `0` expired, `1` valid, `2` under review, `220` PCT designated expiration, `221` PCT designated period, `999` unconfirmed.

stemming.description: Whether to turn on truncation: `1` is on, `0` is off.
